title: レボリューションは突然に

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Seeking the Pearl and I are enjoying some honeyade on our way back from an outing.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Geez, this is addictive! It's so soothing on the throat!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Plus, it's full of nutrients, right? It's got so much potential…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should try mixing it in some miso soup.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm not! Combining it with another nutrient-dense food would create the ultimate superfood!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha! This will be sure to become an indispensable drink for pre-race preparations and training sessions!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl goes ahead and tries mixing together honeyade and miso soup. We both take a sample of the result, but…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yuuuuck! It's like the sweetness and saltiness are battling each other for dominance, and we're the losers in their fight!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It seems that simply mixing them won't cut it. I'll need a little help from some machinery!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Look at this rotation speed… Yep, this might just do it! Let's take my experimental drink to the spinning teacups, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We'll use the centrifugal force of the ride to combine the honeyade and miso soup on a microscopic level!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Round and round it spins! GO, GO, GOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've never be spun around so intensely in my life! After getting this thoroughly mixed, surely it should be tasty! Right? …Right?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Disguuusting! It tastes even more revolting than when I just stirred them together!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now it feels like the sweet and salty flavors are actively working together to ravage my tongue!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: There isn't a chance in high heaven anyone could enjoy this. We have to try and find a way to make it taste better!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I could try chilling it with ice to brighten the flavor…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Or maybe I could use the tannins from tea leaves to balance the flavors out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter what she tries, the mixture ends up tasting repulsive. Making a tasty honeyade and miso soup concoction is proving to be quite difficult.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This could be the superfood I've been dreaming of—it has the perfect amount of nutritional value and untold supportive possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …The reason it doesn't taste good must be down to my inexperience. I'm lacking in both technique and expertise.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I've got no other choice but to study up. If I don't deepen my knowledge on miso soup, I'll never be able to make progress.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm going to apprentice at a famous restaurant so I can master combining miso soup and honeyade!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl appears to be at her wit's end. I stop her just before she bolts off to who knows where.
choice_data_list: It's times like these that call for a bowl of miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, you're right. Let's take a step back and plan our next move.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Slurp…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Delicious! It tastes nothing like how it is with honeyade added to it.
choice_data_list: They both sure taste great when you drink them separately, don't they?
They both sure taste great when you drink them separately, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, they really do. When you drink them on their own, their flavors don't clash at all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey… hold up! Does this mean that so long as you don't drink them simultaneously, things might actually turn out okay?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Even though I just had miso soup, I don't feel grossed out at all by the honeyade! And yet, I'm getting the nutrients from both!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I get it now! The answer is to pair them like cheese and crackers instead of forcing them together like chocolate milk!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I was so preoccupied with creating the perfect honeyade-miso mix, I completely missed the solution that was staring me in the face!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Which means… the amount of foods to possibly pair with miso soup has just expanded in an instant! Trainer, we must go at once!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Look at all the wonderful foods sparkling like gems! Any one of them has the possibility of going perfectly with miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: For example—how about that curry over there?! Pairing turmeric and miso soup could improve circulation and stave off the cold!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Having some apple pie after a meal would be nice, too! You could absorb all the essential vitamins from the fruit, making it the ideal combination!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I never imagined that taking a step back could broaden my horizons and reveal so many possibilities! It's all thanks to you for stopping me!
choice_data_list: We should share our findings with the world!
We'll need to do even more research on this!

text_block_list.text: I never imagined that taking a step back could broaden my horizons and reveal so many possibilities! It's all thanks to you for stopping me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You're right! Let's use social media to spread the word!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Hi, everyone! How about livening up your dinner tonight with some miso soup and apple pie?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Give it a try! It's the perfect pairing for getting all your essential nutrients in one go!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl's post kickstarts a #WithMisoSoup trend as people begin flooding social media with new food pairing suggestions.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We certainly do! There's a treasure trove of food here. We can try anything!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Vanilla ice cream might be a good choice. Paired with miso soup, it could help you recover energy when you're feeling fatigued.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Avocado would be a perfect match with miso soup as it can help remove excess salt from your body! Haha, there really are endless possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl becomes completely absorbed in her research, trying to cover every possible combination.
